pages.text: Most Arcane Gems have an internal reservoir of light, called $()$(bold)charge$(). Once a gem's charge runs out, it becomes $()$(bold)dun$() and cannot be used until recharged. When a gem goes dun, you can attempt to recharge it, usually by activating the dun gem while holding it. Each gem has a unique method of recharging noted on its individual page.

In addition to their own unique recharging methods, Arcane Gems can be recharged by consuming a handful of $()$(bold)Chromatic Powder$() matching its color. In the case of gems that can consume specific items to recharge, the specific item will always be consumed before the Chromatic Powder.

In addition to Chromatic Powder matching a its color, any Arcane Gem can be recharged with $()$(bold)Full-Spectrum Chromatic Powder$(). An Arcane Gem will always try to consume single-color powder before consuming full-spectrum powder.
Gems contained within a $(l:arcanearchives:items/gemsocket)Gem Socket$(/l) will attempt to recharge themselves once upon going dun.
$()$(bold)Arcane Arsenal$() is disabled in config; these features are not available.
